reference.origin: User-approved Chesscom original image preserved in ChatGPT Library. Not in Git and never substituted by third-party SWAT.

identities.sven: Human scout; blue-black tactical armour, balaclava/helmet, compact firearm held at believable contact points, agile crouched silhouette; no generic unmasked plastic figure.
identities.dieter: Human rifleman; heavier olive/dark field gear, visibly distinct helmet and broad equipment silhouette, rifle ready with believable hand grips.
identities.matthias: Ivory chess-pawn-headed commander with peaked cap, pale officer coat, dark cloak trimmed red; NEVER replace with a generic human soldier.

requirements: Match silhouette, face/head protection, outfit, equipment and rifle against the approved image at actual game zoom.
Feet grounded and natural crouch/locomotion; arms hold gun, no detached weapons.
Eight genuinely different Blender views of one authored rig, then 96 true authored frames; neither stage may silently publish or replace 3D fallback.
